question: What is NovaDesk?
answer: NovaDesk is a cloud workspace that combines team chat, documents, tasks and AI search so your team can find answers and finish work faster.

question: Who can use NovaDesk?
answer: Anyone can use it. Freelancers, startups, schools and large companies all use NovaDesk to organise projects and share knowledge.

question: Which languages does NovaDesk support?
answer: NovaDesk is available in English, Spanish, French, German, Hindi and Japanese, and we add new languages every quarter.

question: Where is the company located?
answer: NovaDesk is headquartered in Austin, Texas, with remote teams across Europe and Asia.

question: Is there a mobile app?
answer: Yes. Our iOS and Android apps let you chat, edit documents and manage tasks from your phone.

question: How does NovaDesk work?
answer: Create a workspace, invite your team, then add channels, documents and tasks. The AI search finds anything across them in seconds.

question: Which apps does NovaDesk integrate with?
answer: NovaDesk connects with Google Drive, Slack, GitHub, Jira, Zoom and Dropbox, and offers a REST API for custom integrations.

question: How do I create an account and register?
answer: Click Register on the home page, enter your name, email and a password, then confirm your email address. It takes under two minutes.

question: How do I verify my email address?
answer: Open the verification email we send after registration and click the confirm button. The link stays valid for 24 hours.

question: How do I reset my password?
answer: If you forgot your password, click Forgot password on the login page, enter your email, and follow the link we send to change it.

question: How do I change my email address?
answer: Go to Settings, then Profile, enter the new email and confirm it using the verification message we send.

question: How do I delete my account?
answer: Open Settings, then Account, then Delete account. Your workspace data is permanently removed after 30 days.

question: How do I enable two-factor authentication?
answer: Go to Settings, then Security, and turn on two-factor authentication. Scan the QR code with any authenticator app.

question: How do I invite team members?
answer: Open your workspace, click Invite, and enter email addresses. Invited people receive a link to join instantly.

question: What is AI search?
answer: AI search understands the meaning of your question and finds matching messages, documents and tasks, even when you use different words.

question: Does NovaDesk have templates?
answer: Yes. More than 80 templates cover meeting notes, project plans, roadmaps, onboarding checklists and weekly reports.

question: Can I export my data?
answer: Yes. You can export documents as PDF or Word and download all workspace data as CSV or JSON from Settings, then Export.

question: Can multiple people edit a document at the same time?
answer: Yes. Real-time collaboration shows live cursors, comments and suggestions, so teams can edit together without conflicts.

question: Does NovaDesk provide analytics dashboards?
answer: Yes. Dashboards show task progress, team activity and response times, and you can share reports with a link.

question: Can I use NovaDesk offline?
answer: The mobile and desktop apps work offline. Your changes sync automatically when you reconnect to the internet.

question: Is there an API for developers?
answer: Yes. The REST API lets you manage workspaces, documents and tasks. Create an API token under Settings, then Developers.

question: What plans and pricing do you offer?
answer: We offer Free, Pro at 9 dollars per user monthly, and Business at 19 dollars per user monthly. Enterprise pricing is custom.

question: Is there a free trial?
answer: Yes. Every paid plan includes a 14-day free trial with all features, and no credit card is needed to start.

question: What payment methods do you accept?
answer: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, PayPal and bank transfer for annual Business and Enterprise plans.

question: Can I get a refund?
answer: Yes. If you are unhappy, request a refund within 30 days of your first payment and we will return the full amount.

question: How do I upgrade or downgrade my plan?
answer: Go to Settings, then Billing, then Change plan. Upgrades apply immediately and downgrades take effect at the end of the billing cycle.

question: Do you offer discounts for students or nonprofits?
answer: Yes. Students, educators and registered nonprofits get 50 percent off. Send proof of status to our billing team.

question: How can I contact customer support?
answer: Use the chat button inside the app or email support@novadesk.example. Business and Enterprise customers also get phone support.

question: What are your support hours?
answer: Our support team is available Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 8 PM Eastern Time. Enterprise customers get 24/7 coverage.

question: Which browsers are supported?
answer: NovaDesk works on the latest versions of Chrome, Firefox, Safari and Edge. Please keep your browser updated.

question: What are the system requirements?
answer: You only need a modern browser and an internet connection. The desktop app supports Windows 10 or later and macOS 12 or later.

question: Where can I check if NovaDesk is down?
answer: Visit our status page to see live uptime and incident reports, and subscribe there to receive outage alerts.

question: How quickly will support respond?
answer: Most requests get a reply within 4 hours. Urgent issues from paid plans are answered within one hour.

question: I cannot log in to my account. What should I do?
answer: Check your email and password, then try resetting your password. If it still fails, clear your browser cache or contact support.

question: The page is not loading or loads very slowly.
answer: Refresh the page, check your internet connection, and disable extensions that block scripts. Check the status page for outages.

question: I am not receiving emails from NovaDesk.
answer: Look in your spam folder and mark our emails as safe. Make sure your email address is correct in Settings, then Profile.

question: My files are not syncing across devices.
answer: Confirm you are signed in to the same account and online on both devices. Use Settings, then Sync, then Force sync.

question: File upload fails with an error.
answer: Files must be under 100 MB. Check your connection, try another browser, and make sure the file type is supported.

question: The app keeps crashing or freezing.
answer: Update to the latest app version, restart your device, and reinstall if needed. Send us the crash report from Help, then Report a bug.

question: What data does NovaDesk store?
answer: We store your account details and the content you create. We never read your private content for advertising.

question: Is my data encrypted?
answer: Yes. Data is encrypted with TLS in transit and AES-256 at rest, and keys are rotated regularly.

question: Do you sell my data to third parties?
answer: No. We never sell personal data. We only share it with trusted processors needed to run the service, under strict contracts.

question: Is NovaDesk GDPR compliant?
answer: Yes. We comply with GDPR and CCPA, offer data processing agreements, and let you access or erase your data at any time.

question: How can I request deletion of my personal data?
answer: Email privacy@novadesk.example or use Settings, then Privacy, then Delete my data. We process requests within 30 days.

question: Do you back up my data?
answer: Yes. We back up all data every day and keep copies in multiple regions, so your work is protected against failures.

question: Does NovaDesk provide 24/7 customer support?
answer: Yes, NovaDesk provides customer support 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
